angle: Unlock your iPhone's hidden camera grid feature for better photos.
hook: Want to take better photos? Enable this hidden iPhone feature!
script: Want to take better photos? Enable this hidden iPhone feature! Go to Settings, tap Camera, and switch on the Grid option. This simple trick will help you align your shots perfectly using the rule of thirds. No more lopsided pictures or awkward framing! Trust me, it’s a game changer for capturing stunning images. Follow for more tips!
